prompt: Can you review this bit of website copy and help me make it really work?

assertions.text: Flags it as describe/persuade marketing-speak failing the postures (no story, no understanding/mirror)
Prescribes ADDING the right devices (fire, statement question, consequence lead) and a call-to-mirror instead of the generic CTA
Correctly treats under-use as the defect here (recommends adding), not over-use
